intended_object: The vertex support of a finite edge set E: the set of vertices that lie on (are endpoints of) some edge in E, i.e. ⋃_{e∈E} e. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The body takes the union over e ∈ E of `Sym2.toFinset e`, the finset of endpoints of e. This is exactly the set of vertices incident with some edge of E. Diagonal elements s(v,v) contribute {v}, which is the right answer for a loop, and the empty edge set gives the empty set. The only hypothesis used is `DecidableEq V`, which finset unions need, and the vertex type is arbitrary, so the generality is natural. Mathlib has `SimpleGraph.support` (a `Set`, defined for graphs) but nothing that computes this for a `Finset (Sym2 V)`, so there is no counterpart to cite.
